raw_market.question: Will Willian Pacho finish in the top 2 of the 2026 Ballon d'Or?
raw_market.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the listed player finishes in the top 2 of the men's 2026 Ballon d'Or ranking. Otherwise, the corresponding market will resolve to "No".

The 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony is scheduled to take place in London on October 26, 2026.

If more than 2 players tie for the top 2 in the award ranking, resolution will follow France Football's official top 2 list. Any players tied at the same placement with no further official distinction will be resolved alphabetically by name.

If the award is postponed after November 9, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, canceled, or the final two places have not been determined within this timeframe, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from France Football and/or UEFA, including the official Ballon d'Or announcement; a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

raw_market.question: Overwatch: Falcons vs SEIJI ESPORTS - Game 1 Winner
raw_market.description:
This market refers to the Overwatch match between Falcons and SEIJI ESPORTS in the OCS Korea Stage 3 Regular Season, initially scheduled for October 16, 2026 at 4:00 AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Falcons" if Falcons win Game 1 against SEIJI ESPORTS.

This market will resolve to "SEIJI ESPORTS" if SEIJI ESPORTS win Game 1 against Falcons.

If the match begins but is not completed, and Game 1 is concluded with a winner determined, this market will resolve based on the completed Game 1. 

If Game 1 is not completed for any reason, this market will resolve 50-50. 

If the match is canceled (not played at all), this market will resolve 50-50.

If the match is postponed, it must be rescheduled to a start time on or before October 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET (14 calendar days after the originally scheduled start of October 16, 2026 at 4:00 AM ET). If, by that deadline, the most recently announced rescheduled start time is on or before the deadline, this market resolves based on the result of the match as played. Otherwise, this market resolves 50-50, regardless of whether the match is subsequently played.

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://liquipedia.net/overwatch/Main_Page. However, if https://liquipedia.net/overwatch/Main_Page has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.
